description: This file defines a Python class 'TestCopier' responsible for copying and converting web platform test files from a source repository to a destination directory, with logic for skipping certain files, handling references, and converting files as needed.

classes.name: TestCopier
classes.description: A class responsible for copying and converting web platform test files from a source repository to a destination directory, including logic for skipping files, handling references, and converting files as needed.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the TestCopier with host, source repository path, and destination directory name, setting up filesystem and path variables.

methods.name: do_import
methods.description: Starts the import process by finding importable tests and then importing them.

methods.name: find_importable_tests
methods.description: Walks through the source directory to identify tests to import, applying filters and parsing test info.

methods.name: find_paths_to_skip
methods.description: Reads W3C import expectations to determine which paths should be skipped during import.

methods.name: import_tests
methods.description: Converts and copies the identified tests to the destination directory, logging summary info.

methods.name: copy_file
methods.description: Converts and copies a single file if applicable, handling conversion, copying, and permissions.

methods.name: should_try_to_convert
methods.description: Determines whether a file should be converted based on its type and destination path.
